prompt: Based on what you know about me, create a tarot card in the classic Rider-Waite style. Draw me as a hand-drawn figure, using bold but imperfect black ink lines with slight jitters and variations, flat colors and no shadows. Overlay subtle tarot visual elements around the figure. Add paper texture and a printed feel.

promptZh: 基于你对我的了解，请创建一个 经典 Rider-Waite 风格 的塔罗牌。将我描绘为 手绘人物，使用粗犷但略显不完美的黑色墨水线条，带有轻微的抖动和变化，采用平涂色彩且无阴影。在人物周围叠加微妙的塔罗牌视觉元素。添加纸张纹理和印刷质感。
